scope: Metadata and the exact comparison claims stated in related-work.tex; algorithmic basis of the new ordinary-KEM proof. Reading coverage is listed per source.
access_note: Direct downloads of the five ePrint PDFs returned HTTP 403. Their primary publisher/IACR abstracts support the recorded comparison claims; no full-proof reading is attributed to those five papers. The Squirrel author PDF and official FIPS 203 were inspected directly.

entries.title: Optimal Channel Security Against Fine-Grained State Compromise: The Safety of Messaging
entries.checked_claim: Repeated fine-grained state compromise in bidirectional channels and the use of key-updating encryption/signatures.

entries.title: Determining the Core Primitive for Optimally Secure Ratcheting
entries.checked_claim: Combined state and randomness compromise in ratcheted key exchange, and key-updatable KEMs under the stated strong definitions.

entries.title: Towards Leakage-Resilient Ratcheted Key Exchange
entries.checked_claim: Bounded leakage in unidirectional ratcheted key exchange and key-updatable KEM constructions.

entries.title: Handling Adaptive Compromise for Practical Encryption Schemes
entries.author_version_note: Revised 18 July 2023; the strengthened equivocable definition is recorded in the primary abstract.
entries.checked_claim: A framework for adaptive compromise in practical encryption and pseudorandom-function constructions in ideal models.

entries.author_version_note: The 2024 author version identifies the original EUROCRYPT 2023 publication.
entries.checked_claim: Modular and shared-ideal-primitive composition under adaptive compromise.
